$comment: Issue #46 [E46] — every message a person can see while doing money work. A screen must reference a message id; it must never write its own sentence.

text.en-IN: Not enough stock. You have {available} {unit} of {itemName} at {warehouseName}. This bill needs {required} {unit}, so {shortfall} {unit} are missing.
text.hi-IN: Stock kam hai. {warehouseName} mein {itemName} ke {available} {unit} hain. Is bill ke liye {required} {unit} chahiye, yaani {shortfall} {unit} kam hain.

why.en-IN: We count what you can sell as what is lying in the godown minus what is already kept aside for other bills.
why.hi-IN: Bech sakne wala maal = godown ka maal, minus doosre bill ke liye rakha hua maal.

label.en-IN: Record the purchase that brought this stock in
label.hi-IN: Jis kharid se maal aaya, use darj karein

label.en-IN: Ask someone with permission to allow it and give a reason
label.hi-IN: Permission wale se ijaazat lein aur kaaran likhein

text.en-IN: {reserved} {unit} of {itemName} are kept aside for bills that are not finished yet.
text.hi-IN: {itemName} ke {reserved} {unit} un bills ke liye rakhe hain jo abhi poore nahin hue.

why.en-IN: Stock is held from the moment a bill is started, so two people cannot sell the same goods.
why.hi-IN: Bill shuru hote hi maal rakh liya jaata hai, taaki do log ek hi maal na bech dein.

label.en-IN: See which bills are holding it
label.hi-IN: Dekhein kaunse bill rok rahe hain

text.en-IN: We cannot work out the GST yet. We do not know which state this sale counts in for {partyName}.
text.hi-IN: GST abhi tay nahin ho sakta. Pata nahin ki {partyName} ki yeh bikri kis rajya ki maani jayegi.

why.en-IN: The state decides whether one combined GST applies or two separate ones. We will not guess it, because a wrong choice has to be corrected with the government later.
why.hi-IN: Rajya se hi tay hota hai ki ek GST lagega ya do. Hum andaaza nahin lagayenge, kyunki galti baad mein sarkar ke saath sudhaarni padti hai.

text.en-IN: This app does not handle {scenario} yet, so we will not put a GST figure on this bill.
text.hi-IN: Yeh app abhi {scenario} nahin sambhaalti, isliye is bill par GST nahin lagayenge.

why.en-IN: We only calculate tax for the situations we have checked against official rules. Saying nothing is safer than saying something wrong.
why.hi-IN: Hum sirf un halaton ka tax nikaalte hain jinhe sarkari niyamon se jaancha hai. Galat batane se behtar hai kuch na batana.

label.en-IN: Check with your tax advisor and record the bill outside this app
label.hi-IN: Apne tax salahkaar se poochein aur bill is app ke bahar rakhein

text.en-IN: {partyName} would owe you more than you allow. Their limit is {limit}, they already owe {outstanding}, and this bill of {billValue} takes them {excess} over.
text.hi-IN: {partyName} par aapki tay seema se zyada baaki ho jayega. Seema {limit} hai, pehle se {outstanding} baaki hai, aur {billValue} ka yeh bill unhe {excess} zyada le jaata hai.

why.en-IN: We add up unpaid bills and bills that are not finished yet, so the figure does not surprise you later.
why.hi-IN: Hum bina chukaye bill aur adhoore bill dono jodte hain, taaki baad mein hairaani na ho.

label.en-IN: Allow it anyway and give a reason
label.hi-IN: Phir bhi ijaazat dein aur kaaran likhein

text.en-IN: {periodName} is closed, so this entry cannot be dated {documentDate}.
text.hi-IN: {periodName} band hai, isliye is entry ki taarikh {documentDate} nahin ho sakti.

why.en-IN: Once a month is closed, its figures have usually been reported. Changing them would make your reports and your filings disagree.
why.hi-IN: Mahina band hone ke baad uske aankde aam taur par report ho chuke hote hain. Unhe badalne se report aur filing alag ho jayenge.

label.en-IN: Use a date in an open month
Ask someone with permission to reopen {periodName}
label.hi-IN: Permission wale se {periodName} kholne ko kahein

text.en-IN: {periodName} is closed for good and cannot be reopened.
text.hi-IN: {periodName} hamesha ke liye band hai, dobara nahin khulega.

why.en-IN: This month has been filed. Correcting it now is done with a fresh entry in an open month, linked to the old one.
why.hi-IN: Yeh mahina file ho chuka hai. Sudhaar ab khule mahine mein nayi entry se hota hai, jo purani se judi rehti hai.

label.en-IN: Make the correction in the current month

text.en-IN: This was already saved a moment ago as {documentNumber}, so we opened it instead of making a second one.
text.hi-IN: Yeh abhi thodi der pehle {documentNumber} ke roop mein save ho chuka tha, isliye naya banane ke bajaay wahi khola gaya.

why.en-IN: A slow network can make one tap look like two. We check before creating anything.
why.hi-IN: Slow network mein ek tap do jaisa lag sakta hai. Isliye banane se pehle jaanch hoti hai.

text.en-IN: Bill {supplierBillNumber} from {supplierName} is already in your books as {existingDocument}.
text.hi-IN: {supplierName} ka bill {supplierBillNumber} pehle se {existingDocument} ke roop mein darj hai.

why.en-IN: Recording the same supplier bill twice would double your stock, your dues and the GST you can claim later.
why.hi-IN: Ek hi supplier bill do baar darj karne se stock, dena aur baad mein milne wala GST dogune ho jaate hain.

label.en-IN: This is a different bill, change the bill number
label.hi-IN: Yeh alag bill hai, bill number badlein

text.en-IN: {partyName} has paid {paid} against {documentNumber}. {outstanding} is still due.
text.hi-IN: {partyName} ne {documentNumber} ke liye {paid} de diya hai. {outstanding} abhi baaki hai.

why.en-IN: A bill is marked paid only when the whole amount has been received.
why.hi-IN: Bill tabhi chukta maana jaata hai jab poori rakam mil jaaye.

text.en-IN: {extra} extra was received from {partyName}. It is kept for them and is not linked to any bill yet.
text.hi-IN: {partyName} se {extra} zyada mila. Woh unke naam rakha hai, abhi kisi bill se juda nahin.

why.en-IN: We never decide on your behalf which bill extra money belongs to.
why.hi-IN: Zyada paisa kis bill ka hai, yeh hum aapki taraf se tay nahin karte.

label.en-IN: Link it to a bill now

text.en-IN: Cheque {chequeNumber} from {partyName} for {amount} did not clear. Their dues are back to {restoredOutstanding}.
text.hi-IN: {partyName} ka {amount} ka cheque {chequeNumber} clear nahin hua. Unka baaki phir se {restoredOutstanding} ho gaya.

why.en-IN: We do not delete the old record. We add an opposite entry, so you can always see what happened.
why.hi-IN: Purana record mitaaya nahin jaata. Ulti entry jodi jaati hai, taaki hamesha dikhe ki kya hua.

text.en-IN: Please check: sell {quantity} {unit} of {itemName} to {partyName} at {rate} per {unit}, price {taxBasis}. After this you will have {stockAfter} left.
text.hi-IN: Zara jaanch lein: {partyName} ko {itemName} ke {quantity} {unit}, {rate} prati {unit}, rate {taxBasis}. Iske baad {stockAfter} bachega.

why.en-IN: We repeat what we understood before anything is recorded, because a misheard number costs real money.
why.hi-IN: Kuch darj karne se pehle hum samjhi hui baat dohraate hain, kyunki galat suna hua number asli nuksaan karta hai.

text.en-IN: We are not sure about the {fieldLabel}. We heard "{heardValue}".
text.hi-IN: {fieldLabel} ke baare mein pakka nahin hai. Humne "{heardValue}" suna.

why.en-IN: Numbers like seventeen and seventy sound alike. We ask instead of choosing one.
why.hi-IN: Satrah aur sattar jaise number milte-julte lagte hain. Isliye hum chunne ke bajaay poochte hain.

text.en-IN: {optionCount} customers have names like "{spokenName}". Which one did you mean?
text.hi-IN: "{spokenName}" jaise naam wale {optionCount} customer hain. Aapka matlab kaunsa tha?

why.en-IN: Billing the wrong customer moves money to the wrong account and is slow to correct.
why.hi-IN: Galat customer ka bill banne se paisa galat khaate mein jaata hai aur sudhaarna mushkil hota hai.

text.en-IN: This needs approval from {approverRole} because {reason}.
text.hi-IN: Iske liye {approverRole} ki manzoori chahiye kyunki {reason}.

why.en-IN: Your business asked for a second pair of eyes on this kind of entry.
why.hi-IN: Aapke business ne is tarah ki entry par doosri nazar maangi hai.

label.en-IN: Change it so approval is not needed
label.hi-IN: Aisa badlein ki manzoori na chahiye

text.en-IN: You cannot {actionLabel} with your current access.
text.hi-IN: Aapke maujooda access se aap {actionLabel} nahin kar sakte.

why.en-IN: Access is set by the business owner so that money work stays with the right people.
why.hi-IN: Access maalik tay karte hain, taaki paise ka kaam sahi logon ke paas rahe.

text.en-IN: Please write why you are going ahead. This is saved with your name and the time.
text.hi-IN: Kripya likhein ki aap kyun aage badh rahe hain. Yeh aapke naam aur samay ke saath save hoga.

why.en-IN: Later, someone will ask why this was allowed. The answer should be in the record, not in memory.
why.hi-IN: Baad mein koi poochega ki yeh kyun hone diya. Jawab record mein hona chahiye, yaad par nahin.

text.en-IN: {documentNumber} has already been issued, so it cannot be changed.
text.hi-IN: {documentNumber} jaari ho chuka hai, isliye badla nahin ja sakta.

why.en-IN: The customer and the government may already have this bill. Corrections are made with a new linked document, so both versions stay visible.
why.hi-IN: Yeh bill customer aur sarkar ke paas ja chuka ho sakta hai. Sudhaar naye jude hue document se hota hai, taaki dono dikhein.

text.en-IN: {documentNumber} is saved in your books, but {serviceName} is not responding right now.
text.hi-IN: {documentNumber} aapke hisaab mein save hai, lekin {serviceName} abhi jawab nahin de raha.

why.en-IN: Your books do not wait for a government service. We will keep trying and never create a second one.
why.hi-IN: Aapka hisaab sarkari service ka intezaar nahin karta. Hum koshish karte rahenge aur doosra kabhi nahin banayenge.

label.en-IN: Leave it, we will keep trying
label.hi-IN: Rehne dein, hum koshish karte rahenge

text.en-IN: This vehicle looks too small. The goods weigh about {loadKg} kg, but {vehicleNumber} is registered as a {vehicleClass}.
text.hi-IN: Yeh gaadi chhoti lag rahi hai. Maal ka wazan lagbhag {loadKg} kg hai, lekin {vehicleNumber} {vehicleClass} ke roop mein registered hai.

why.en-IN: A vehicle that cannot carry the load is usually a typing mistake, and it can be questioned on the road.
why.hi-IN: Jo gaadi itna maal utha hi nahin sakti, wahan aam taur par typing ki galti hoti hai, aur raaste mein sawaal ho sakta hai.

text.en-IN: Saving…
text.hi-IN: Save ho raha hai…

why.en-IN: Nothing is recorded until this finishes.
why.hi-IN: Jab tak yeh poora na ho, kuch darj nahin hota.

text.en-IN: Done. {documentNumber} is recorded in your books.
text.hi-IN: Ho gaya. {documentNumber} aapke hisaab mein darj hai.

why.en-IN: Your stock, your dues and your GST have all been updated together.
why.hi-IN: Aapka stock, dena-lena aur GST sab ek saath update ho gaye.

text.en-IN: It did not go through. Nothing was recorded, so you can safely try again.
text.hi-IN: Yeh nahin hua. Kuch darj nahin hua, isliye aap bina fikar dobara koshish kar sakte hain.

why.en-IN: We save the whole entry or none of it. There is no half-saved bill.
why.hi-IN: Ya poori entry save hoti hai ya bilkul nahin. Aadha bill jaisa kuch nahin hota.

label.en-IN: Keep it as an unfinished bill

text.en-IN: You are offline. This is kept on your phone as an unfinished bill and is not in your books yet.
text.hi-IN: Aap offline hain. Yeh aapke phone par adhoore bill ki tarah rakha hai, hisaab mein abhi nahin gaya.

why.en-IN: Stock, numbering and GST are checked on the server, so a bill becomes final only when your phone reaches it.
why.hi-IN: Stock, number aur GST server par jaanche jaate hain, isliye bill tabhi poora hota hai jab phone server tak pahunche.

label.en-IN: We will finish it when you are back online
label.hi-IN: Online aate hi hum ise poora kar denge
